caption: The drawing depicts several fruit-bearing branches set against a light beige background. The branches are brown with scattered green leaves that feature darker and lighter green shading. Clusters of grapes in red, yellow, and purple colors are distributed along the branches. In the lower central area, there are two large round fruits that are likely peaches, colored in shades of yellow, orange, red, and accented with purple highlights. The composition repeats these elements, with the fruit clusters and leaves appearing at intervals around the picture. The image is bordered by a wide, off-white margin.
